data.title: PR-15 exit evidence: crash windows and cancellation points replay exactly

data.body: [HIGH][CWE-754][risk:high] The retained machine verdict is not fail closed over the evidence it claims. all_met checks six replay tallies and only four campaign predicates. It omits e.probes, the honesty and time declarations, the binding unsupported case, boundary and journal-doctor checks, retained findings_none, run-count equality, crash-plan coverage, and required compared-count cardinality. The artifact test at lines 3953-3982 accepts that partial aggregate as verdict met with fail_closed true. A targeted artifact run can therefore retain met while a named hon, neg, or bnd test would fail. Make every named subclaim produce an explicit result and require all results before met. Failure modes: unsupported behavior can become recordable, declared coverage can drift, a campaign can lose runs or crash plans, or a negative check can fail while the normative JSON remains met. Edge cases: empty probe sets, zero crash plans, changed retained findings, missing compared counters, time gaining operations, and binding CrashUnsupported drift. Rollback: keep PR-15-EXIT active and do not promote this artifact, or revert the delivered-status and artifact range until the aggregate is complete. Monitoring: reject any met artifact whose required artifact IDs and predicates lack explicit passing results, and alert on test-to-artifact coverage drift. Validation: add mutation tests for each omitted predicate and assert that each independently forces verdict not-met. Static review preserves the separate risk:critical human gate.

[HIGH][CWE-682][risk:high] The retained negative claim says every cancellation point moved one step is a typed divergence, but the harness does not establish that claim. At lines 1480-1500 it skips the check whenever the next step is not the program step, because both cancellation points cancel the same program work. It also has no later point at the final boundary. The golden records 480 network and 360 storage skipped moves, while only 276 and 396 moved-point divergences exist. Dropped cancellation also has 128 and 86 no-op points. START_HERE_IMPLEMENTATION.md:416 and PLAN_REQUIREMENTS.json:2187 repeat the universal divergence claim and mark the exit satisfied. Either move cancellation across the next meaningful program step and test every applicable point, or narrow the retained claim and delivery prose to detected, commuting, and no-op classes with exact accounting. Failure modes: a machine reader treats untested or equivalent moves as detected divergence and accepts stronger replay evidence than exists. Edge cases: adversary or scheduler steps after the point, the terminal boundary, no remaining program step, and consecutive non-program steps. Rollback: keep PR-15-EXIT active and revert the satisfied status or the whole evidence range until the claim matches the exercised semantics. Monitoring: require moved-divergence plus explicitly equivalent plus terminal counts to equal cancellation-point counts for every pack. Validation: retain a per-point disposition and add assertions for every category, then make the JSON and plan text derive from those qualified results. Static review preserves the separate risk:critical human gate.
